title: Web Service returning max of 1000 entries
symptom: The local web service API only returns a maximum of 1000 readings (less than 4 days worth) even when using the 'count' option and setting 'all_data=Y'. The xDrip database contains many thousands of bg readings.
cause: The web service is not intended to serve data for reporting; the limit of 1000 is a design choice.
fix: No fix was provided in the thread. Suggestions included modifying the source code to increase the limit or implement pagination, but no official resolution was given.
evidence_quote: A 1000 is a pretty big record count for a response from a web service. I guess its intention is not to serve data for reporting.
